chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
"When you place your forehead on your prayer mat, do not lift it, but drag it along the ground."

key_terms.نَبَكَةٍ: prayer mat (a small piece of cloth or leather used for prostration)

ai.seo_question: How should one position the forehead during prostration according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) refines the physical mechanics of sujdah, emphasizing a continuous, dragging motion of the forehead to maintain humility and prevent premature rising. It highlights the Shia emphasis on precise adherence to the Prophet's and Imams' prescribed manners (adab) in prayer, ensuring the act remains one of total submission rather than mere ritual movement.
